sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 38135 of 2023
Petitioner :- Smt. Jayprabha

Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Man Mohan Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the second respondent to decide the application dated 30.08.2023 filed by the petitioner for payment of compensation in light of the award dated 26.02.2015 in land acquisition reference no.35 of 2012,
under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
2.

While making reference under Section 30 of the Land Acquisition Act, the compensation amount is deposited before the Court, therefore, the application has to be filed before the Court for release of the money.

Smt. Jayprabha vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53985053/
1 3.

sentences.text: The writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to move appropriate application before the Court for release of money in accordance with law.
